svg.data-weight-note: 9.08 lb (4.12 kg) in the user guide, as one figure for the whole SX II family
svg.data-power-input: 100 to 240 VAC auto-switching, 50 to 60 Hz, 0.35 A, two C14 inlets (data sheet and user guide)
svg.data-serial-pinout: DTE or DCE detected by the port; RJ45 pins in user guide Appendix A, printed pp. 54 and 55
svg.data-usb-admin: USB 2.0 mini-B Admin port for a laptop (data sheet and features sheet)
svg.data-modem: none on this model; the M models add an internal telephone modem
